source_evidence: Exact player 'Announce myself, state my business, and see how it goes' explicitly delegates V's announcement consistent with existing stated claim. V says 'I am Viscount Valenthia of House Vaishnavi. I have returned to reclaim my family’s ancestral holdings, and I understand this tower operates under a charter connected to my House.' Gate guard learns stated identity/title and reason, briefly goes inside to fetch existing mortal antiquarian administrator; after several minutes gate opens and administrator emerges at entrance, visible silver-haired older gentleman with embroidered burgundy coat, no visible weapon, ordinary DM appearance detail. He politely says he has encountered Vaishnavi name in studies, never expected to meet bearer, bows and offers audience inside to hear discoveries. This is ordinary willingness to meet a claimant with relevant historical name, no recognition of V's personal ancient identity, proof of genealogy, concession of modern title, admission of abuse, unrestricted archive access or transfer of possession. Administrator has only what guard just conveyed, no road patrol report confirmed, does not yet know Silverward discoveries or heart. V has not accepted invitation or entered; party/coach remain at southern approach, fixed four-retainer roster unchanged except gate guard briefly summoned administrator and returned with him; roof lookout in place, interior guard and Spy retain posts, no reinforcements. No contested request or check, no spending, no attack/initiative. Time D333~15:42. V next choice whether accept audience and what disclose.
